name: IndoNLU
description: The first comprehensive benchmark and resource suite for Indonesian natural language understanding, covering twelve diverse tasks from single sentence classification to pair-sentence sequence labeling across multiple domains and styles.
reputation: Widely cited as the first comprehensive Indonesian NLU benchmark and a standard reference for Indonesian language understanding research.
notes: Includes Indonesian pre-trained models (IndoBERT) and a benchmark evaluation framework; datasets collected from social media, blogs, news, and websites.
